meta_description:
2,998 likes, 110 comments - dr.rishabh2970 on September 15, 2026: "INI-CET ≠ NEET PG! 🔥

If you’re preparing for INI-CET, don’t follow the exact same strategy you used for NEET PG.

Some subjects carry relatively higher importance in INI-CET — especially Anatomy and Forensic Medicine.

8 subjects you NEED to make strong:

1. Anatomy 🦴
2. Biochemistry 🧬
3. Pathology 🔬
4. Pharmacology 💊
5. Microbiology 🦠
6. Surgery 🔪
7. Obstetrics & Gynaecology 👶
8. Forensic Medicine ⚖️

Get these 8 subjects rock solid, and you’ll have a strong foundation for a great INI-CET rank.

Don’t prepare harder. Prepare strategically.

Save this reel & start strengthening these 8 subjects today.".
